capabilities.current_evidence_or_remaining_work: Indexed/unindexed triangle buffers, live aspects and ordinary transforms through Graphic3d factories; unlit and opaque Phong-family solid styles (docs/vulkan-lighting.md). Twelve native viewer captures plus CPU submission and live Vulkan mutation tests. Both lavapipe and native RADV profiles retain PNG/depth captures and explicit device identity.

Orthographic/perspective snapshots and structure/group transform persistence reach Vulkan. Nineteen persistence modes: 240 total captures pass on lavapipe; native AMD retains 34 strict persistence failures (two one-pixel edges and depth errors up to approximately 4.1e-6 on common-color pixels). Viewport/local-anchor and live-camera isolation CPU regressions; depth-clamp/lifecycle GPU checks on both profiles. Structure CameraPers requires depthClamp. Native raster parity, stereo, tiled/large-coordinate behavior remain open. See vulkan-persistence-worktree-2026-10-10.json and persistence-diagnostics-2026-10-10. Subsequent raster precision diagnosis: all 114 host persistence controls pass at explicit 8-bit native snapping; 30 software control depth failures show this is not a universal oracle. Default comparisons and timing baseline remain unchanged. See docs/vulkan-raster-precision.md.

V3d ToPixMap reaches Vulkan through framebuffer targets; RGBA8 and D32 readback, RGB/red conversion and padded/bottom-up rows tested. sRGB attachments now match native default color encoding, with a midtone GPU regression. MSAA, HDR, tiled capture, configurable color spaces and alternate formats remain pending.

Graphic3d factories and V3d creation/redraw/resize support offscreen and native X11 windows. AIS lifecycle, mode changes and affinity submit actual presentations; built-in line, point, axis, plane-trihedron and circle datums, opaque highlights and shadow geometry have functional coverage. Native window presentation, resize, rebind, remap and multiple-window cases pass on both profiles (docs/vulkan-window-presentation.md). Broader AIS presentations/highlights, connected structures, subviews, cached immediate redraw, other window systems and surface/device-loss recovery remain open.

Native Xlib swapchains, GPU blits, FIFO/unsynchronized modes, resize, rebind, remap, multiple windows, actual drawable captures and release presentation timings; see docs/vulkan-window-presentation.md. Requires swapchain-maintenance1 presentation fences. Other platforms, broader surface formats and device/surface-loss recovery remain open.

Graphic3d triangle strips/fans are lowered to triangle lists with per-bound assembly and colors; vertex colors take precedence. CPU buffer tests and native capture scenarios cover indexed/unindexed arrays. Segments/polylines, widths and shader line patterns now reach Vulkan; varying-color/depth fixtures retain strict differences documented in docs/vulkan-lines.md. Indexed point arrays and native screen-space sprites now reach Vulkan with a 1,024-point batching workload; raster/color parity remains partial (docs/ais-point.md). Quads/polygons, normals, edges, silhouettes, polygon offsets and general group stencil commands remain open. Opaque face culling, mirrored structure winding and internal cap stencil passes are covered in docs/vulkan-capping.md. AIS_Circle and all StdPrs_DeflectionCurve overloads now submit adaptive circular/arc datums, with boundary/filled selection, nineteen capture modes and geometry-update timings (docs/ais-circle.md).

Material packing matches 417 native records. Opaque PhongFacet/Gouraud/Phong now reach Vulkan through retained normals and directional/point/spot/head lights, separate front/back materials, vertex colors and clipping. Both devices pass 15 analytic lighting scenes and validation checks; native captures pass 124/126 on lavapipe and 64/126 on AMD. Strict pixel parity, timing gates, PBR, shadows and lit capping remain open; docs/vulkan-lighting.md records all failures and measurements.
PBR IBL, cubemaps, environment backgrounds and baking.
Texture formats, samplers, UV transforms and custom shader contract.
Alpha mask/blend, sorted transparency, weighted OIT and depth peeling.

Live view/structure planes, local overrides, unions within chains and intersections across chains reach immutable Vulkan fragment submissions. Persistent anchors, local model coordinates, bounding-box rejection and font zero-plane policy have paired native scenes. See docs/vulkan-clipping.md for capture and performance evidence. Homogeneous position weights now reach GPU transforms, including zero-weight directions needed by capping; see docs/vulkan-homogeneous-vertices.md for strict clipping-boundary gaps. Opaque unlit stencil capping now preserves native closed-group/instance masks, chain filters, transforms and selected object appearance. Native capping captures pass 148/150 on lavapipe and 135/150 on AMD; strict failures remain recorded in docs/vulkan-capping.md. Lit/hatched/textured sections, broader combinations and platform profiles remain unfinished; no renderer family is complete.

Standard and user point sprites, alpha-only highlighted sprites, AIS_Point selection/detection, runtime validation and a batched performance workload are implemented. Strict raster/color/highlight differences remain recorded in docs/ais-point.md. Retained Graphic3d_Text now uses ported FreeType/formatter adapters, indexed glyph atlases, fixed-size/zoomable billboards, oriented anchors and annotation depth policy. Eighteen modes and a 1,024-glyph workload exercise both profiles. Strict text raster parity, additional display modes and broader billboard behavior remain open; see docs/vulkan-text.md. AIS_Axis and both DsgPrs_XYZAxisPresentation overloads now retain actual labels. Unblended coverage and the fixed native font cutoff support inherited line aspects; five alpha-mode/cutoff captures and an axis appearance workload accompany the new datum modes (docs/ais-axis.md). AIS_PlaneTrihedron adds two labeled axes with independent arrow/text aspects, live plane/length updates, fourteen capture modes and geometry-update timings (docs/ais-plane-trihedron.md).

Ordered normal/immediate layers, priorities and depth clear/test/write submitted to Vulkan; solid background, default/full native captures and custom depth-policy runtime assertions. Layer removal preserves structures. View frustum culling now uses the ported Graphic3d traversal and native BVH invalidation, including On/Off/NoUpdate state. Gradient/image backgrounds, layer origin, distance/size culling and complete immediate-pass behavior remain open.
Legacy ray tracing, path tracing, GI, sampling, DOF and tone mapping.
Stereo modes, anaglyph/interlaced output, external composer and HMD paths.
Performance counters, HUD/chart, diagnostics and GPU memory reports.

Owned Vulkan buffers/images/pipelines, repeated frame resize and invalid device tested; caching, sharing and context/device loss remain pending. Release benchmarks cover redraw, 256 draws and resize on software/native devices with compatible-baseline regression budgets; allocation caching and GPU-only timing remain open.
